# [STORY] As an operator, I want facade cache hardening and load-tested SLOs, so that the read-through cache stays correct and fast under real concurrent traffic

## User Story
**As an** operator
**I want** facade cache hardening and load-tested SLOs
**So that** the read-through cache stays correct and fast under real concurrent traffic

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given many concurrent requests miss the cache for the same key, when single-flight is active, then only one upstream call happens, not a thundering herd (`MovieServiceConcurrencyTest.getMovieById_ConcurrentMisses_ShouldSingleFlightUpstreamCall`, `MovieServiceConcurrencyTest.getMovieCategoryRaw_ConcurrentMisses_ShouldSingleFlightUpstreamCall`)
- [x] Given Gatling load tests run, when traffic hits the target SLOs, then the measured P95 is reported for both paths (`GatlingPerformanceTest.runGatlingSimulation_ShouldGenerateReport` asserts the report is generated; ARCHITECTURE.md §12.4 records P95 18ms cache-served and P95 279ms TMDB-fallback against 200ms/800ms targets — the test asserts the report exists, not the SLO values themselves, so a regression is caught by reading the report, not by the build going red)

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 8

## Closing this Story
Both child Tasks (native sub-issue links: #44, #45) are closed and their acceptance criteria are proven by `MovieServiceConcurrencyTest` and `GatlingPerformanceTest`.
